description.en: I, Yvonne, reincarnated into an otome game as the rich villainess. According to the game's plot, a character loathed by everyone such as myself has the main role of bullying the heroine, pushing her towards the various love interests' romantic routes. But it seems like there's something wrong with Elsa, the heroine! She's getting too close to me!
description.es: Yo, Yvonne, reencarné en un juego otome como la villana. Según la trama del juego, un personaje detestado por todos como yo tiene el papel principal de acosar a la heroína, empujándola hacia las rutas románticas de los distintos intereses amorosos. Menurut plot permainan, karakter yang dibenci oleh semua orang seperti aku memiliki peran utama menindas sang heroin, mendorongnya ke berbagai rute romantis minat cinta. Tapi sepertinya ada yang salah dengan Elsa, sang heroine! Dia terlalu dekat denganku!

Она становится слишком близка ко мне!

description.en:
After being defeated and captured, the dragon slayer Leon became a captive of the Silver Dragon Queen. With the awareness of death, he used forbidden magic to curse the queen, but unexpectedly, the queen lost control. 

He thought that this would make the queen live with shame for the rest of her life, and it would be worthy of the dragon slayer's mission. 

But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, next to him was a little dragon girl with a tail...
description.id: Setelah dikalahkan dan ditangkap, Dragon Slayer Leon menjadi tawanan Silver Dragon Queen. Dengan kesadaran akan kematian, dia menggunakan sihir terlarang untuk mengutuk sang ratu, tetapi secara tak terduga, sang ratu kehilangan kendali. Dia berpikir bahwa ini akan membuat sang ratu hidup dalam rasa malu seumur hidupnya, dan itu akan sepadan dengan misinya sebagai pemburu naga. Namun, dua tahun kemudian, ketika Leon membuka matanya, di sampingnya ada seorang gadis kecil naga dengan ekor...

Він думав, що це змусить королеву жити з соромом до кінця життя, і це буде гідно титулу вбивці драконів.

description.en:
Nie Li became the strongest Demon Spiritualist and stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage-Emperor and six deity-ranked beasts.  
  
His soul was then brought back to when he was still 13 years old. At this point in his life, Nie Li was considered to be the most pathetic of his peers. However, with the vast knowledge he accumulated from his previous life (his future), he began becoming stronger faster than anyone could expect. He also decided to help those who died nobly in his previous life become stronger as well.  
  
Aiming to avert the future destruction of his home by demon beasts, and to avoid his previous fate of ending up destroyed, Nie Li fights to protect his lover, friends, family and fellow citizens who died in the beast assault or its aftermath. He also aims to destroy the so-called "sacred family," who will abandon their duty and betray the city.
description.ru: Сильнейший в мире заклинатель демонов Не Ли погиб в битве с Мудрецом-Императором. Но его душа воплотилась вновь, вернувшись на десятилетия назад, в нём самом, тринадцатилетнем подростке. Теперь у него есть шанс исправить все ошибки, совершённые в прошлом: спасти от монстров родной город, защитить любимую, друзей и семью. В детстве Не Ли был самым слабым учеником в классе, имея духовную силу на уровне простых людей. Он и мечтать не смел стать воином, не говоря уже о заклинателе демонов, но опыт и знания, накопленные в предыдущей жизни, помогут ему стать сильнее. Ведь сейчас он знает то, что неведомо профессорам в их боевой академии.
description.es-la: Nie Li, el más fuerte Espiritista Demoníaco, en su vida pasada estuvo en la cima del mundo marcial, sin embargo, perdió la vida durante la batalla con el Sabio Emperador y sus bestias, al morir fue devuelto al pasado cuando tenía 13 años gracias a la ayuda del Libro Temporal del Demonio Espiritual y aunque en este momento él es el más débil de su clase con la ayuda de los vastos conocimientos que acumuló de su vida anterior, se transformara en un guerrero formidable.
description.pt-br: Nie Li, o mais poderoso Espiritualista Demoníaco e estando no topo do mundo marcial, perde sua vida durante a batalha com o Imperador Sábio e as seis bestas de nível divino, e sua alma volta ao passado para quando ele tinha 13 anos. Embora ele seja o mais fraco em sua classe, com o talento mais baixo no reino da alma Vermelho – o mais fraco dos reinos – com a ajuda de seu vasto conhecimento acumulado na sua vida passada, cresce mais rápido do que todos. Agora, ele irá tentar proteger a cidade que no futuro será invadida pelas bestas e que acabou sendo destruída, assim como sua amada, seus amigos e sua família que morreram pelo ataque das mesmas, e destruir a família Sagrada que abandonaram seus deveres e traíram a cidade em sua vida passada.

description.en:
Green Tea Bitch (n.): A woman who pretends to be pure and innocent but is in fact manipulative and calculating.

When school ends, a good honor student is threatened by the class's green tea bitch.
"I never thought a wide-eyed goody-two-shoes like you would get up to something like that."
"If you don't want me to expose your shameful secret..."

A cute romance that stems from a misunderstanding begins in *That Time I Was Blackmailed By the Class's Green Tea Bitch*!
description.pt-br:
"Chá Verde" (subst.): Uma mulher que finge ser pura, fofa e inocente, mas que na verdade é falsa, calculista e manipuladora.

Tongtong tem a fama de ser a maior "chá verde" do colégio. Um dia, ela encurrala a aluna exemplar Lin Luxi para uma conversinha em particular.
"Quem diria que a perfeitinha da sala teria uma vida íntima tão... agitada. Se não quiser que eu espalhe seu segredinho por aí, vai ter que fazer tudo o que eu mandar."

O que começa como um grande mal-entendido rapidamente floresce para algo a mais... Prepare-se para uma comédia romântica colegial fofa e cheia de reviravoltas, estrelando uma patricinha que, no fundo, tem um coração puro, e uma aluna exemplar que esconde um lado astuto e masoquista!

W czasach starożytnych istniało wiele różnych sztuk walki, niestety świat przeszedł przerażające zmiany i pozostały tylko trzy: Sztuka Ognia, Smoka i Gwiazd. Pokolenia ekspertów z tych trzech sztuk poszukują drogi do nieśmiertelności. Użytkownik Sztuki gwiazd wyrusza w podróż, by stać się najwyższym z bogów.

description.es-la: Del autor de tales of demons and gods: en todo el mundo se establecen doce rutas para escalar la torre de dios, y hay leyendas de que estas doce vías conducen hacia el legendario camino de la inmortalidad. sin embargo, estas dos rutas en la torre de dios, son demasiado largas, sin fin. en tiempos antiguos una vez había muchos tipos de artes marciales, lamentablemente el mundo experimento cambios terribles y quedaron sólo tres: llamadas, artes marciales flama, dragón y estrella. generaciones de expertos en las tres artes marciales buscan el camino de la inmortalidad. una estrella marcial prácticamente en su viaje de la vida, con dos jóvenes bellezas a su lado, planea convertirse en el dios más grande.
description.pt-br: No mundo existem doze caminhos para subir a torre de Deus, e contam as lendas que estes doze caminhos levam a lendária estrada da imortalidade. No entanto, esses caminhos da Torre de Deus, são exageradamente longo, sem fim. Nos tempos antigos haviam muitos tipos de artes marciais mas infelizmente o mundo passou por mudanças horríveis e restaram apenas três: a arte marcial da Chama, do Dragão e da Estrela. As Gerações de especialistas dessas três artes marciais estão a procura da estrada da imortalidade. Praticantes das Artes Marciais da Estrela, juntamente com a geração jovem, tentam durante toda sua vida encontrá-la para se tornar o Deus mais forte.

Athanasia Cloix, a woman whose elegance and beauty is akin to that of a swan lake, was the Duke’s eldest daughter and the Queen of the social circles: an existence near to perfection. Due to some rumors, however, people began to misunderstand and belittle her. As she suffered through these unfortunate events, she learned to conceal her feelings by putting on a façade and agreed to a political marriage with the Winter-comer who's also known as the “Northern Monster.”

description.en:
Chu Qing, a Swordsman, accidentally entered the Fairy Realm 300 years ago. During those 300 years, he began his cultivation journey. Upon reaching the Realm of Eternity, he unexpectedly opened the Hall of Time and Space and returned to the time he was 17 years old and lived on the Earth. But, it turned out that it wasn't the same Earth he once lived in. It was a reversed world where Women act like Men and vice-versa! And hence, his journey to conquer all the strong women of this 'Reverse World' and return to his previous world began. [Written by MCITGAMER.]  


---
description.fr: Chu Qing est un cultivateur expert en sabre, qui est entré accidentellement dans le monde des fées il y a 300 ans. C'est au cours de ces 300 ans qu'il a commencé son voyage de culture. Au moment d'atteindre le royaume de l'éternité, on ne s'attendait pas à ce qu'il ouvre plutôt le hall du temps et de l'espace et qu'il revienne sur terre à l'âge de 17 ans. Mais lorsqu'il a vu la situation, il s'est avéré que ce n'était pas la terre dans laquelle il avait vécu autrefois, mais le monde était inversé entre les rôles des femmes et des hommes. Comment s'est déroulé son voyage pour trouver un moyen de revenir au monde originel, et de vaincre et conquérir les femmes fortes du monde…
description.pt-br: Chu Qing é um cultivador de espadas que há 300 anos entrou acidentalmente no mundo das fadas. Durante os 300 anos começou sua viagem de cultivação, e no momento em que estava prestes a alcançar o Reino da Eternidade, inesperadamente abriu um portal no espaço e tempo e acabou retornando para a terra, mas na idade quando ele tinha 17 anos. Quando Chu Qing se deu conta da situação, não era a terra que ele viveu uma vez, mas agora o mundo estava invertido no papel das mulheres e dos homens na sociedade. "Mas o que está acontecendo? Agora as mulheres são total autoridade?" Conheça como foi a viajem para ele encontrar o caminho de volta ao seu tempo original, e derrotar e conquistar as mulheres que são o poder absoluto neste novo mundo…

description.en:
The peak of martial arts is solitary and lonely. It is an endless pursuit for unattainable heights as well. In order to surpass the limits of martial arts, growth and the will to survive in adverse situations is necessary.
One day, Yang Kai, a disciple-on-trial (and floor sweeper) of the Lingxiao Martial Arts Sect discovered a Wordless Black Book. That marked the turn in his luck and the beginning of his martial arts journey.
description.fr: Le chemin vers le sommet martial (Martial Peak) est long et solitaire. Face à l’adversité, il faut survivre et persévérer. Il est alors possible de percer et poursuivre l'ascension pour devenir le plus fort. Le Haut Pavillon Céleste entraîne ses disciples de la manière la plus sévère afin de les préparer à ce voyage. Un beau jour, le modeste balayeur Yang Kai met la main sur un livre noir, le lançant sur la route vers l'apogée du monde martial.
description.ru: Путь на вершину боевых искусств - путь одинокий и длинный. Перед лицом невзгод ты должен оставаться сильным и неотступным. Только тогда ты сможешь преодолеть все препятствия и стать по-настоящему сильным. Небесная Башня обучает своих учеников самым суровым образом, чтобы они могли выстоять в мире боевых искусств. Но только из-за одного самого незначительного проступка наш главный герой, Янг Кай, может быть исключен из Небесной Башни.
description.uk: Шлях до бойової вершини - самотній, відлюдний і довгий. Перед обличчям негараздів ти повинен вижити і залишатися непохитним. Тільки тоді ти зможеш прорватися і продовжити свій шлях, щоб стати найсильнішим. Небесна вершина випробовує своїх учнів найсуворішими способами, щоб підготувати їх до цієї подорожі. Одного разу скромному підмітальнику Ян Каю вдалося роздобути чорну книгу, яка відкриває йому шлях до вершини світу бойових мистецтв.
description.vi: Võ đạo đỉnh phong, là cô độc, là tịch mịch, là dài đằng đẵng cầu tác, là cao xử bất thắng hàn Phát triển trong nghịch cảnh, cầu sinh nơi tuyệt địa, bất khuất không buông tha, mới có thể có thể phá võ chi cực đạo. Lăng Tiêu các thí luyện đệ tử kiêm quét rác gã sai vặt Dương Khai ngẫu lấy được một bản vô tự hắc thư, từ nay về sau đạp vào dài đằng đẵng võ đạo.
description.zh: 《武炼巅峰》漫画版是由深圳漫画团队噼咔噼绘制，根据阅文集团旗起点中文网的同名小说改编，作者是莫默。武之巅峰，是孤独，是寂寞，是漫漫求索，是高处不胜寒。逆境中成长，绝地里求生，才能堪破武之极道。凌霄阁试炼弟子兼扫地小厮杨开偶获一本无字黑书，从此踏上漫漫武道。
description.es-la: El viaje hacia la cima marcial es solitario y largo. Ante la adversidad, debes sobrevivir y permanecer inflexible. Solo entonces podrás avanzar y continuar tu viaje para convertirte en el más fuerte. El "Pabellón Cielo Alto" pone a prueba a sus discípulos de las formas más duras para prepararlos para este viaje. Un día, el humilde barrendero Yang Kai logró obtener un libro negro, lo que lo puso en el camino hacia la cima del mundo marcial.
description.pt-br: A jornada para o Pico Marcial é algo longo e solitário. Indo de encontro com a adversidade, você deve sobreviver e permanecer vivo. Apenas aqueles que superarem os limites continuarão a jornada rumo ao objetivo de se tornar o mais forte. A Sky Tower testa seus discípulos de maneiras bem complexas para esta jornada. Um dia, o menosprezado Yang Kai conseguiu obter um livro negro, fazendo-o tomar rumo ao pico do mundo marcial.

Because he had the heritage of the ancient Demonic Emperor, Demonic Emperor Zhuo Yifan met the misfortune of being betrayed and killed by his trusted disciple. After being reborn, his cultivation went back to zero and he was trapped by a heart demon, given no choice but to become the housekeeper of the Luo Family's lone eldest miss. From being a Magic Emperor to being an insignificant housekeeper, how would he get along with his "heart demon eldest miss" and what power would he gain in order to lead himself and the declining family to rise back to the peak of the continent!

description.en: Lin Jie is an otherworlder who manages a bookstore. He’s kind and always recommends soul-healing books for his dejected customers. Sometimes he’d even share his own works too. As time goes on, these customers start to respect him a lot. They bring simple local products every day to show their gratitude and ask for book recommendations. They even start telling tales of this ordinary shopkeeper. His respectful and cordial titles include “Hyena of the Evil God”, “Herald of the Flesh Gospel”, “Author of Cultes des Goules” and “Shepherd of the Stars”???
description.uk: Лінь Цзє – чужоземець з іншого світу, що став тепер звичайним власником книжкового магазину. Вони щодня приносять йому маленькі сувеніри чи подарунки в знак подяки та просять у нього рекомендації щодо книги. Про цього звичайного крамаря навіть починають розповідати історії. description.en:
In this world, respect is earned with martial arts. Weak martial artists have strengths of tens of thousands of pounds, capable of cracking boulders. And the strong ones can cut off rivers and split mountains. There are even martial kings who know everything and can travel across the universe. Martial art decides your fate as well as your life and death. The weak is humiliated while the strong looks down on the world. This is a a world where the strong bullies the weak. People's statuses are decided by the levels of their cultivation of martial arts. Each faction fights for the title of "The Strongest". Only the strong ones have the right to survive. Even if you are from the same clan or faction, if you are weak, then you will be bullied and kicked out without mercy.  
  
After a car accident, Lin Feng crosses over to this new world into the body of a young master from the powerful Lin Family.  
Will Lin Feng be used by others again or will he forge his own path in this place where, regardless of your family ties or sect, only the strong have the right to live.  


---
description.fr: Dans ce monde, le respect se gagne avec les arts martiaux. Les artistes martiaux faibles ont des forces de dizaines de milliers de pounds, capables de craquer des blocs rocheux. Et les plus forts peuvent couper les rivières et creuser des montagnes. Il y a même des rois martiaux qui savent tout et peuvent voyager à travers l'univers. L'art martial décide de votre destin ainsi que de votre vie et de votre mort. Les faibles sont humiliés tandis que les forts méprisent tout le monde. C'est un monde où les forts intimident les faibles. Les statuts des gens sont déterminés par les niveaux de culture des arts martiaux. Chaque faction se bat pour le titre du "plus fort". Seuls les forts ont le droit de survivre. Même si vous appartenez au même clan ou à la même faction, si vous êtes faible, alors vous serez persécuté et expulsé sans pitié.
description.pt-br: Neste mundo, o respeito é obtido através das artes marciais. A força de artistas marciais fracos é igual a dezenas de milhares de libras, capazes de quebrar rochas. E os fortes podem cortar rios e dividir montanhas. Há até reis marciais que conhecem tudo e podem viajar pelo universo. A arte marcial decide seu destino, bem como sua vida e sua morte. Os fracos são humilhados enquanto o olhar forte para o mundo. Este é um mundo onde os fortes intimidam os fracos. O status das pessoas é decidido pelos níveis de cultivo de artes marciais. Cada facção luta pelo título de "O mais poderoso". Apenas os fortes têm o direito de sobreviver. Mesmo se você é do mesmo clã ou facção, se você é fraco, então você será intimidado e expulso sem piedade.

He swears he'll protect the people important to him this time round and reunite with his past lover. Watch his struggles to survive equipped with his memory of the next ten years!
description.fr: uo Tianchen est l'un des derniers survivants sur terre depuis qu'une épidémie venant de l'espace s'était abattue sur terre, il l'y a de cela 10 ans. Alors qu'il est sur le point de mourir, Zuo fît donc ses adieux à sa petite amie qu'il avait rencontré durant l'épidémie. C'est alors que, d'un coup, alors qu'il était sur le point de mourir, il retourna dans le temps 10 ans auparavant, quelques heures avant le début de l'épidémie. C'est alors qu'il décida de sauver son meilleur ami qui avait périt dès le début de l'épidémie, 10 ans auparavant, et c'est alors qu'il se met à la recherche de sa copine qu'il avait dans l'ancienne apocalypse.

Следите за его приключениями, в которых он использует свои воспоминания о следующих 10 годах, чтобы выжить и спасти своих близких!

description.en:
Xiao Yao, a young lady of a wealthy, respectable family in the 21st century, thought her life had ended when she passed away due to a deadly illness. However, she opened her eyes and found herself in the body of a manhua's villainess, Princess Abella.  
  
Despite not having any magic powers nor capabilities, the pompous and vicious Princess caused countless people to suffer from her heinous acts. Her greed for the throne even led her to murder her own father, thus sentencing her to death while the protagonists of the manhua lived happily ever.  
  
With a second chance at life in such a healthy body, Xiao Yao will not sit back idly while the Princess' impending doom befalls her again. This time, she will strive to change the Princess' fate, and along the way, will attempt to discover her hidden secrets and of those around her…  


---
description.fr:
Xiao Yao, une jeune femme d'une famille riche et respectable au 21ème siècle, pensait que sa vie avait pris fin quand elle est décédée à cause d'une maladie mortelle. Cependant, elle ouvrit les yeux et se retrouva dans le corps de la méchante d'un manhua, la princesse Abella.  
  
En dépit de ne pas avoir de pouvoirs magiques ni de capacités, la princesse pompeuse et vicieuse a fait souffrir d'innombrables personnes de ses actes odieux. Son avidité pour le trône l'a même amenée à assassiner son propre père, la condamnant ainsi à mort alors que les protagonistes du manhua vivaient heureux pour toujours.  
  
Avec une seconde chance à la vie dans uncorps sain, Xiao Yao ne va pas rester les bras croisés tandis que le destin imminent de la princesse la menace à nouveau. Cette fois, elle s'efforcera de changer le destin de la princesse, et en cours de route, tentera de découvrir ses secrets cachés et ceux de ceux qui l'entourent…

description.en:
As the grandmaster who founded the Demonic Sect, Wei WuXian roamed the world in his wanton ways, hated by millions for the chaos he created. In the end, he was back-stabbed by his dearest junior brother and killed by powerful clans that combined to overpower him. He incarnates into the body of a lunatic who was abandoned by his clan and is later, unwillingly, taken away by a famous cultivator among the clans—Lan WangJi, his archenemy.  
  
This marks the start of a thrilling yet hilarious journey of attacking monsters, solving mysteries, and raising children. From the mutual flirtation along the way, Wei WuXian slowly realizes that Lan WangJi, a seemingly haughty and indifferent poker-face, holds more feelings for Wei WuXian than he is letting on.
description.pl:
Wei Wuxian, założyciel demonicznej sekty, przemierzał świat w swój rozpustny sposób, znienawidzony przez miliony za chaos, który wywołał. Ostatecznie został zdradzony przez swojego najdroższego shidi i zamordowany przez potężne klany, które złączyły siły, by go pokonać. Po kilkunastu latach ocknął się w ciele szaleńca, który został porzucony przez rodzinę. Niedługo później siłą zostaje przygarnięty przez Lan Wangji, jego arcywroga. Tak rozpoczyna się trzymająca w napięciu i wywołująca śmiech wędrówka złożona z pokonywania potworów i rozwiązywania tajemnic. I kto im zabroni trochę poflirtować po drodze?

description.en:
Eight hundred years ago, the pure-blooded and noble Crown Prince, Xie Lian, was a well-regarded child of heaven with unlimited boundaries. However, who knew that after ascending, achieving immortality and becoming a Martial God that thousands of people worshipped, that his life would only go downhill. He was demoted and fell down the ranks until he reached rock bottom.  
  
Eight hundred years later, Xie Lian has ascended once again, but this time he has neither the followers nor any incense burned in his name. One day, on his way back from collecting trash, he picks up a mysterious youth and takes him home. This particular youth however, actually turns out to be Hua Cheng, the infamous Ghost King known throughout the three realms who could change both his gender and appearance at the flip of a dime.  
  
NOTE: Heaven Official's Blessing has been re-released on bilibili from the prologue with some special extras due to the original release not being very coherent unless you've read its source material (novel). This is the new version.
description.id:
Delapan ratus tahun yang lalu, Putra Mahkota berdarah murni dan mulia, Xie Lian, adalah anak surga yang dihormati dengan batas yang tidak terbatas. Namun, siapa yang tahu bahwa setelah naik, mencapai keabadian dan menjadi Dewa Perang yang disembah ribuan orang, bahwa hidupnya hanya akan menurun. Dia diturunkan dan peringkatnya menurun sampai mencapai titik terendah.  
  
Delapan ratus tahun kemudian, Xie Lian telah naik sekali lagi, tetapi kali ini ia tidak memiliki pengikut atau dupa yang terbakar dalam namanya. Suatu hari, dalam perjalanan kembali dari mengumpulkan sampah, ia bertemu seorang pemuda misterius dan membawanya pulang. Namun pemuda khusus ini, ternyata adalah Hua Cheng, Raja Iblis yang terkenal di tiga alam yang dapat mengubah jenis kelamin dan penampilannya dengan cepat.
description.pl:
Osiemset lat temu czystokrwisty i szlachetny Książę Koronny, Xie Lian, był wysoce poważanym dzieckiem Niebios z nieograniczonymi możliwościami. Jednak kto by się spodziewał, że po wzniesieniu się do Niebios, osiągnięciu nieśmiertelności i zostaniu Bogiem Wojny, którego czciły tysiące, jego życie całkiem się rozpadnie. Został wygnany, aż osiągnął dno.
Osiemset lat później Xie Lian znowu wzniósł się do Niebios, ale tym razem nie miał ani popleczników, ani nikt nie palił w jego imieniu kadzidła. Pewnego dnia, wracając z kolejnego dnia spędzonego na zbieraniu złomu, spotkał tajemniczego młodzieńca i zabrał go do domu. Ten okazał się być Hua Chengiem, Królem Demonów cieszącym się złą opinią we wszystkich trzech wymiarach.

Теперь нельзя поручиться, что тело подростка, в котором находится моя девятисотлетняя сущность в одно прекрасное утро не лишится своего целомудрия.  
  
И, похоже, мой гарем в новом мире будет лишь непрерывно расти…
description.pt-br: Mestre celestial Tsundere, irmã de seios grandes, cultivadora de veneno descalça, espadachim imortal com roupas de seda branca, as últimas 5 das 6 pessoas mais fortes do mundo. Eu, Ye Gulou, me tornei a primeira pessoa a cultivar a imortalidade através do Yang puro e ilimitado. Mas espere, cultivar Yang puro e ilimitado significa que não posso formar relacionamentos com mulheres ou então morrerei?! Então o que posso fazer sobre esse meu harém que cresceu tanto ao longo dos anos? Eles estão todos me perseguindo, me coagindo a escolher entre eles (senão eles vão me matar). Eles me forçaram a ascender aos Céus, à imortalidade agora mesmo para escapar de sua ira. Oh merda, eles me seguiram para o novo mundo?!! Vamos ver o que nos espera enquanto meus haréns de ambos os mundos se combinam!

Having her identity changed and unable to return to her family, she abandoned them, but, if she doesn't take revenge on those who caused her harm, will she be worthy of the title "The Ghostly Doctor"? As clouds gather, heroes fight to be the strongest! How will she conquer the world in a red robe, and fight among the strong heroes?!

description.en:
Our hero, Mo Fan, inherits a magical necklace—the next day, he wakes up to find that the world has changed. His high school now teaches magic, and students are encouraged to try and become accomplished magicians. A world that ran on science now runs on magic. However, some things are still the same. He still has a teacher who sees him as a hopeless student, classmates who look the same, a father who struggles to make ends meet, and a not-by-blood little sister who can't walk on her own.
However, Mo Fan discovers that the vast majority of magicians can only harness one element of magic. As luck would have it, however, he is an exception—a versatile mage!

(Source: WebNovel)


---
description.it:
Si sveglia e il mondo cambia. La vecchia scuola ora insegna la magia, incoraggiando i suoi studenti a diventare i più grandi maghi che possono essere. Oltre i confini della città, le bestie magiche vagano a caccia di esseri umani.  
  
Il mondo scientifico è diventato un mondo magico. Ma alcune cose non sono cambiate, lo stesso insegnante che lo guarda dall'alto in basso, gli stessi studenti che lo disprezzano, lo stesso padre che lavora sodo per mantenerli, e la stessa sorellastra che non può camminare.  
  
Anche così, Mo Fan ha scoperto che mentre il resto della gente può usare un singolo elemento, lui può usare tutta la magia!
description.pl:
Gdy się obudził, świat nie wyglądał już tak samo. Znajome mu liceum uczy teraz magii, zachęcając uczniów do zostania jak najwspanialszymi magami. Poza granicami miasta zaś wędrują magiczne bestie żerujące na ludziach.  
  
Świat zaawansowanej nauki zamienił się w świat zaawansowanej magii. Nie zmienili się za to nauczyciel i uczniowie, którzy nadal patrzą na niego z lekceważeniem. Tacy sami pozostali też jego ojciec, zmagający się z trudnościami na dnie drabiny społeczeństwa, ani niewinna przyrodnia siostra, która nie może chodzić.   
  
Jednak Mo Fan odkrywa, że mimo iż wszyscy inni mogą używać tylko jednego głównego żywiołu, on sam może używać wszystkich rodzajów magii!!
description.pt-br:
Ele acorda e o mundo mudou. A antiga escola agora ensina magia, encorajando seus estudantes a se tornarem os maiores magos que eles podem ser. Além dos limites da cidade, bestas magicas perambulam caçando humanos.  
  
O mundo cientifico agora se transformou em um mundo magico. Mas ainda, algumas coisas não mudaram, o mesmo professor que olha com desdem para ele, os mesmos estudantes que desprezam ele, o mesmo pai que trabalha muito para sustenta-los, e a mesma meia-irmã que não consegue andar.  
  
Mesmo assim, Mo Fan descobriu que enquanto o resto das pessoas pode usar um único elemento, ele pode usar toda a magia!!

description.en:
Jiang Yang was a lead designer for a popular game company until she fell to her death while gathering inspiration for a new game. After waking up in a world of cultivation, she trained tirelessly to return to her original world, when a thread of fate pulled her into the world of an otome game.

Jiang Yang quickly realizes she is in the world of the very first game she had worked on. The thread of fate connected her to Stardew, the heroine of the game who is being bullied during her first year at the Royal Academy of Magic.

As the game progresses, Jiang Yang remembers the ridiculous story the game follows, and she decides that she can’t stand by while the game makes Stardew suffer. She helps Stardew deal with the flirtatious love interest of the original game, Crown Prince Miller, and even imparts her with some of her cultivation power. To protect Stardew from the game’s story, she even puts herself in danger. However, as Jiang Yang and Stardew’s relationship becomes closer, Jiang Yang realizes that the thread of fate connecting her and Stardew is not as simple as she imagined.
description.zh: 姜央是一名为了游戏新作采风不幸摔下悬崖穿越到修真世界的游戏主美，为了回到原本的世界，姜央努力修炼，终于要飞升成神回到原本的世界，结果因为一条神秘的因果线，被强制牵引到了一个魔法世界中（还是个乙女游戏，游戏刚开始），捡到了初入魔法校园就被恶役女二欺负的的游戏女主。 姜央这时反应过来，这不就是当初让自己穿越的那个倒霉换皮游戏吗？而自己的因果线就连接在了游戏女主星露的身上。姜央以为只要跟着游戏通关，自己就能回到最初的现实世界，但是随着游戏发展，姜央再次回想起了煞笔策划写的沙雕剧情，看着星露受苦，具有强烈责任心和道德感的姜央选择对星露出手相助，不仅要帮对方清理花心皇子那些烂桃花，还传授修真技巧以防对方被其他学生霸凌，甚至有时还得搭上自己的身子！！随着姜央和星露的交往越来越密切，姜央发现自己在星露身上的因果线没有自己想象中那么简单……
description.pt-br:
Jiang Yang é a diretora de designe de arte de um jogo, ao coletar referências para uma nova produção, cai de um penhasco e acaba atravessando para um mundo de cultivo. Para voltar ao seu mundo original, Jiang Yang se dedica ao cultivo e finalmente está prestes a ascender como uma divindade para retornar. No entanto, devido a uma misteriosa linha do destino, ela é forçada a ser puxada para um mundo de magia (que também é um jogo otome, e o jogo acabou de começar). Nesse novo mundo, ela encontra a protagonista do jogo, Xing Lu, sendo intimidada pela vilã secundária logo no início da academia de magia.

Jiang Yang percebe que este é o jogo problemático que a fez atravessar os mundos originalmente. Sua linha do destino está ligada a Xing Lu, a protagonista do jogo. Jiang Yang acredita que, seguindo a história do jogo até o fim, ela poderá retornar ao seu mundo real. No entanto, conforme o jogo se desenvolve, Jiang Yang relembra as tramas ridículas escritas pelo roteirista idiota do jogo. Vendo o sofrimento de Xing Lu, a fortemente responsável e moralmente íntegra Jiang Yang decide ajudar Xing Lu. Ela não apenas ajuda a livrar Xing Lu dos pretendentes indesejados, incluindo o príncipe mulherengo, mas também lhe ensina técnicas de cultivo para que ela possa se defender dos outros estudantes. Às vezes, isso até envolve sacrificar-se fisicamente! 

À medida que Jiang Yang e Xing Lu se tornam mais próximas, Jiang Yang descobre que sua linha do destino com Xing Lu é mais complexa do que ela imaginava...

description.fr: Dès que Gu Changge s’est rendu compte qu’il avait transgressé un monde imaginaire, le protagoniste de ce monde, l’élu de la fortune, a juré de se venger de lui. Envié par tous, non seulement la femme principale est folle de lui, mais il est également traité comme un invité de marque partout où il va. Heureusement, le prestige et le pouvoir de Gu Changge sont supérieurs à ceux de tous les autres, alors il ne devrait pas être facile de piétiner un simple élu de la fortune ?
description.id:
Begitu Gu Changge menyadari dia telah masuk ke sebuah dunia fantasi, protagonis dunia itu yang dengan beruntungnya terpilih, bersumpah untuk melakukan balas dendam terhadapnya. Semua orang sangat iri pada Protagonis itu, karena bukan hanya karakter utama wanita tergila-gila padanya, tapi dia juga selalu diperlakukan sebagai tamu kehormatan kemanapun dia pergi. Untungnya, martabat dan kekuatan Gu Changge jauh melebihi milik orang lain, sehingga dia tidak dengan mudah jatuh di tangan orang yang hanya terpilih karena keberuntungannya?

 

Tunggu dulu… ada sistem yang didedikasikan untuk meraup dan mengambil dari apa yang dimiliki protagonis? Gu Changge tersenyum. “Sepertinya takdir pun ingin aku memenuhi takdirku sebagai orang jahat di dunia ini!”
description.pl: Gu Changge zostaje przeniesiony do świata wuxia, gdzie z miejsca staje się obiektem nienawiści protagonisty, będącego Wybrańcem Losu, gdyż nie dość, że główna bohaterka rzuca mu się w ramiona, to jeszcze jest przez wszystkich traktowany niczym znamienity gość. Na szczęście jego postać cechuje znacząca siła, więc powinien bez trudu zmiażdżyć jakiegoś w czepku urodzonego dzieciaka, prawda? “Chwila… Otrzymałem wyspecjalizowany system, który pozwala mi okradać głównego bohatera ze szczęścia?” Gu Changge uśmiechnął się znacząco. “Zdaje się, że moim przeznaczeniem jest podążanie ścieżką prowadzącą do stania się największym czarnym charakterem w tym świecie!”
description.ru:
Гу Чангэ попадает в фэнтези-мир, где, по-классике, оказывается в шкуре главного козла отпущения.
Удивительно, что главный герой сразу же снизыскал расположение у императрицы, чем вызвал бурю ненависти в свой адрес. К счастью, Чангэ - уважаемый человек в городе и единственное, что его спасает от кары в данной ситуации это высокий статус в обществе. Подождите-ка... а вы уже знаете, что здесь есть необычная система рангов, в которой присутствуют яркие герои всех мастей? Проанализировав события, герой понимает, что выгоднее всего вжиться в свою новую роль и пойти по пути персонажа-злодея!
description.pt-br: Imediatamente após Gu Changge perceber que havia transmigrado para um mundo de fantasia, o protagonista do mundo, e o escolhido da fortuna, jurou se vingar dele. Invejado por todos, ele não só tem a liderança feminina de ponta-cabeça por ele, mas também é tratado como um distinto convidado onde quer que vá. Felizmente, o prestígio e o poder de Gu Changge são superiores aos de todos os outros, então não deveria ser fácil pisar em uma mera escolha da fortuna? Espere … Existe um sistema dedicado à ordenha e colheita do protagonista? Gu Changge sorriu. “Parece que até o destino quer que eu cumpra meu destino como o vilão deste mundo!”

description.en: Two girls are friends, "sisters," and soulmates. Yu Qi, a 17-year-old high school student, wakes up to find that she and her 27-year-old self had switched souls. One has to relive the experience of meeting her lover again and the other has to bear the responsibility of being a girlfriend, despite being unfamiliar with the girl she's dating. Both worlds are always changing, but the only one who never changes is… you, who is always by my side.

Yu was mistakenly killed a few hundred years after the apocalypse. Then, he traveled back in time right before the apocalypse began. Qin Yu rapidly grew into a formidable opponent with his apocalyptic combat experience and skills, overcoming hurdles, saving the world while protecting his beloved younger sister.
description.es: Qin Yu foi morto algumas centenas de anos no futuro durante o apocalipse devido a um erro de julgamento. Ele então viajou de volta no tempo antes do início do Apocalipse, confiando em sua experiência e técnicas de combate do apocalipse, Qin Yu rapidamente se transformou em um oponente formidável, passando por obstáculos, salvando o mundo enquanto protegia sua amada irmã.

It has been a year since Li Fu Chen lost his “Talent”. Now he lives the life of a trash, being bullied and beaten by those who once were inferior to him. However, he still has yet to lose everything as he’s still engaged to a strong and pretty lady of a powerful family but that came to an end when the engagement was abruptly canceled.   
  
With shame brought to the family and his life engulfed by darkness, a ray of hope pierced the sky.

Já faz 1 ano desde que Li Fu Chen perdeu seu “talento”. Agora ele vive a vida de um lixo, sendo intimidado e espancado por esses que uma vez eram inferior a ele. Entretanto, ele ainda não perdeu tudo pois ainda está noivo de uma forte e linda garota de uma poderosa família. Mas que chegou ao fim quando o noivado foi cancelado.

He exploded to death and accidentally got reborn to his 20s back on Earth.

Il a été accidentellement réincarné à sa vingtaine par le livre du ciel. Tout ce qu'il voulait, c'était de devenir immortel et de retourner au monde immortel, et il est devenu l'homme le plus fort de la terre, transformant ses mains en nuages et se couvrant les mains de pluie, provoquant quiconque le défie ! C'est le vénérable ! Le souverain de 3000 mondes ! Le gars qui est 10 000 fois meilleur que Thanos ! Il est Taixuan Taizun ! Le Grand Immortel !

Jiang Bai was killed in a truck accident when trying to escape from a high risk casino after winning a huge amount of money but instead of dying, his soul was transported into a parallel world that is similar to Earth and merge with his alternate pathetic self.   
  
Over there he met the mad god who grant him a powerful BUG ability in this new world. Jiang Bai is now stuck in his alternate world self, who is far weaker and less much influential than his original self.   
  
Can he make a comeback in this new parallel earth with his new cheat abilities?   
  
*Warning: Has Netori a bit*
description.it: Jiang Bai è morto investito da un camion, mentre provava a scappare da un pericoloso casinò nel quale aveva vinto molto denaro; invece di morire, la sua anima è stata trasportata in un mondo parallelo simile alla Terra, e lui è stato fuso insieme al se stesso di quel mondo, che è nient'altro che un perdente. Lì ha incontrato un dio folle che gli ha garantito una potente abilità BUG in questo nuovo mondo. Jiang Bai adesso è incastrato in quel mondo alternativo, dove è molto più debole e molto meno influente di quanto lo fosse nel suo mondo. Riuscirà a sfondare anche in questa Terra parallela con le sue nuove utili abilità?

Su Jiu Qing is the daughter of the first wife of a government official, but her life is anything but pampered. Her father is cruel, her aunt is a hypocrite, and her little white lotus half-sister harbors sinister intentions towards her.  
  
In the past, she was forced to fight for her husband, despite her worsening reputation, and this conflict ultimately led to the scheme that took away her life.

A story of rebirth, inner house struggles and a counterattack from heaven; follow Jiu Qing on her journey to climb the twisting ladders of the social hierarchy.

A thousand years have passed since the Battle of Primordial Chaos. Shaman bloodlines have become thin and tyrannical demonic beasts mostly hide off in remote mountains. The realm now belongs to Humanity, and it is filled with countless conflicts. We descend from our mountain to join this troubled world. We excel at subduing ghosts and sealing devils; we control spirits and souls alike. We are feared and respected in this world. We are called "Heretics."  
  
Society calls the teachings of the Soul-Controlling Sect, which captures and forms contracts with soul beasts in exchange for power, "Heresy." For Mo Lianjian, a young disciple who lost his parents when he was little, ascending within the sect is difficult, especially when his childhood friend, the prodigy Lian Beibei, is always picking fights. One day, Mo obtains a fragment of a legendary sword rumored to have been owned by the sect's last master swordsman…

description.en: Referred to as “The Cobra” by her employees, art director Lu Meihe appears to most as a strict and callous boss but she is actually rather innocent at heart. She has a secret crush on her intern Lin Wenjing, but because of her public image, she cannot express her feelings openly and instead pours them into the sketchbook she always carries with her. One day, she accidentally leaves the sketchbook behind only for it to be discovered by Lin Wenjing. Lu Meihe soon realizes that while Lin Wenjing may seem gentle and carefree, she may actually be hiding a secret persona of her own. Today my intern bullied me again, I’m so happy I don’t know what to do!

Being reincarnated in a cultivation world, Han Jue realizes that he can live his life like a video game. He can reroll his cultivation potential and connate providence.

[Unparalleled: Immortal beauty, top-notch charm]

description.en: What happens when a former martial sovereign gets reborn into a complete loser's body? Gu Feiyang, a legendary martial artist who was ranked third-strongest in the continent, finds himself in this predicament when he wakes up in the body of 15-year-old Li Yunxiao. Li Yunxiao was once a failure who had yet to open a single chakra point in his body, but now he's morphed into a genius martial artist overnight and becomes the talk (and target) of the town. Armed with the expertise of his former life, Li Yunxiao is on a mission to complete the ultimate incantation that killed him in the first place - all while wiping the floor with his former bullies at school. Will he be able to exceed the accomplishments of his previous life? One thing's for certain: no one will ever call him a loser again!
description.es-la: Gu Feiyan, el tercer soberano, muere y es reencarnado en un niño llamado Li Yunxia, una completa basura que todavía no despertó sus meridianos a pesar de su edad. ¡Pero esto no detendrá al MC de alcanzar el pináculo de este mundo otra vez!
description.pt-br: Um dos imperadores marciais conferidos, Gu Feiyang, faleceu nas montanhas Tiandang e reencarnou 15 anos depois como Li Yunxiao, do estado de Tianshui, embarcando em uma jornada que desafia o céu contra os inúmeros gênios da época. Os nove níveis da Arte Marcial; os Reinos Divinos dos dez quadrantes. A partir de então, o mundo inteiro caiu no caos!
